title: Team Shape Canvas
description: Team Topologies assessment (Skelton & Pais): team types, cognitive load, interaction modes, Conway's Law alignment. Added 2026-09-01 as the third of seven 'parse-checked only' canvases, and chosen next because it was the LARGEST body of unvalidated data in the dogfood repo — 61 populated leaves across 20KB, none of it checked by anything. The team-type enum comes from skills/team-shape/SKILL.md, which lists the four fundamental types, NOT from this project's single team. A schema written from one stream-aligned entry would have encoded a sample as the contract.

type.description: Skelton's four fundamental team types, taken from skills/team-shape/SKILL.md. MOST TEAMS SHOULD BE stream-aligned; the doc says so, and a canvas where most are not is the finding the assessment exists to surface. `complicated-subsystem` is conditional in the source — 'only when cognitive load justifies' — which a schema cannot check.

size.description: Permitted as a STRING because a real entry reads '1.5' for a solo human plus agents. Coercing that to a number would lose what the value is saying.

interaction_modes.description: Modes toward other teams. The three legal values are collaboration, x-as-a-service and facilitating. NOT ENUM-PINNED, deliberately: the live shape is a mapping keyed by the other team, and pinning the VALUE side would reject a legitimate structure this project has not settled. Recorded so the next person meets a stated gap rather than a silent one.

teams.description: The teams as they actually are, not as an org chart wishes.

cognitive_load_assessment.description: Intrinsic / extraneous / germane load per team. Only extraneous SHOULD be reduced; intrinsic can be managed but not removed, and germane is encouraged.

conways_law_check.description: Whether the system's shape mirrors the communication structure that built it.

bounded_context_alignment.description: Does each stream-aligned team own a coherent bounded context?

last_assessed.description: ISO date of the last /mycelium:team-shape run. Read against the technical-feasibility 120-day horizon in engine/evidence-decay.md.
